title: Lost Mary Maryliq Cherry Lemon Mint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Elevate your vaping experience with Lost Mary Maryliq's Cherry Lemon Mint, a tantalising trio of flavours that's nothing short of extraordinary. Begin your journey with the luscious sweetness of ripe Cherries, filling your mouth with a berry burst that's irresistibly delicious. But there's more—the citrusy zing of Lemon swiftly follows, adding a layer of complexity and zest. Just when you think it can't get any better, a wave of cool Mint washes over you, leaving your palate refreshed and craving more. The balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures you get the perfect combination of flavourful clouds and a smooth, satisfying throat hit. This e-liquid is a masterful blend, designed for vapers who appreciate depth and variety in their vaping repertoire.
